scope: Mechanical conditional-tree comparison of 1055 observed product source/header files against registered original bytes
excluded_arm_rule: An arm containing only #error and #line is treated as intentionally pruned; its original nested groups are not compared.
limitations: Only preprocessor tree structure is compared, not selected-arm behavior or contexts.
An unmatched selector may be an authorized local condition or a missing original condition; no automatic deletion or restoration is authorized from this report.
Tree sequence comparison stops at each first mismatched scope; additional inner discrepancies may exist.
The separately confirmed generator input has no conditional directives.
